title: Expand Q8_0 up-only pre-fallback skip to full blk.0 ffn_up_exps top1 gate

bottleneck_component.name: DeepSeek decode CPU up/down fallback plus source/page behavior

prior_gate.result: blk.0.ffn_up_exps.weight with max_calls=64 passed fixed-text top1, same_top1=145/145, first_mismatch_pos=-1, NMSE=0
prior_gate.limitation: Only 64 pre-fallback skip calls were tested, so it is not enough coverage for a performance benchmark.

candidate.name: Q8_0 CUDA up skip before CPU fallback, full blk.0 ffn_up_exps coverage
candidate.why_this_step: This expands the first passing pre-fallback skip path to all eligible blk.0 up calls before touching additional layers or running a strict cold benchmark.
candidate.expected_ram_pressure: Same 16GB cgroup as prior verifier; additional temporary CUDA/host buffers scale with one up tensor call at a time, not with full model residency.
candidate.expected_ttft_impact: Not evaluated in this correctness-only run.
candidate.hard_upper_bound: No new token-rate bound is claimed by this run. The broader Q8_0 up-skip family can only become a performance candidate after expanded top1 correctness is stable.

correctness_gate.text: fixed France text used by the previous llama-results verifier
correctness_gate.baseline: skip disabled, write result.gguf and top1-baseline.json
correctness_gate.failure_rule: If top1 fails or the process OOMs, keep this as rejected evidence and do not expand beyond blk.0.

promotion_rule: This run cannot be promoted as SOTA. A later strict cold benchmark is required, with drop_caches, full cgroup memory/page-cache logging, TTFT, prompt/eval token rates, exact France output, correctness decision, commit/push, and pushed-source reproduction.
